original.statement: Loki 3.0.0 recommends enabling WAL and optionally enabling flush_on_shutdown to handle the removal of max_transfer_retries configuration.

decision.reason: This item is not a change in its own right. It is option A of two alternatives listed after the removal of `max_transfer_retries` (`-ingester.max-transfer-retries`) [ev-c6e07f70e7d9]; the other option is B [ev-8ec3d6c379c3]. The cited text only recommends enabling the WAL, with flush_on_shutdown as an optional extra [ev-b19cd3bb8e8b]. The proposed exposure, edge-from-version <3.0.0, flags every environment upgrading to 3.0.0, which is too broad. Per the section, only environments that relied on max_transfer_retries are affected, and that belongs to the removal change, not to this remediation option.
